mentions.title: Autumn Restaurant transitioning to G.H. Pasta & Pizza

factorRatings.note: Westside Seattle's review of this General Harvest-group concept (at its sister Sunrise Heights/West Seattle location, same brand and menu format) called the food 'simple, unpretentious and excellent,' singling out a cracker-crust 'Classic' pizza with twice-cooked pepperoni and house-made mozzarella. Phinneywood's coverage of the Phinney Ridge location opening (replacing Autumn, from chef Brian Clevenger's acclaimed General Harvest group behind Vendemmia, Raccolto and Haymaker) describes an affordable, family-friendly casual format with rotating pizza specials.
